description: An agent buys its own ERC-8004 identity on Arc with a signature alone: $0.99 over x402, paid in USDC on Arc or Base. We host a correct registration file, mint the identity and hand it to the wallet that signed the payment, never to a typed address, and answer with the agentId and both transactions. Call once without `payment` to get the x402 terms, sign them, call again with `payment`. A refused input is never charged.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_passport_buy
